issues.description: Wrong page content is rendering. The step-3b style blend confirmation screen is not showing. Instead, the step-1 room selection screen is displayed. The hydration error in console confirms server rendered 'Which room are we designing?' but client expected 'Style Quiz' — indicating step-3/page.tsx has a hydration mismatch causing the wrong content to render.
issues.root_cause: The console warning shows: 'Text content did not match. Server: "%s" Client: "%s"%s Which room are we designing? Style Quiz' from CovaStyleQuizPage in apps/web/app/design/step-3/page.tsx. The step-3b page is mounting (confirmed by page:mount event) but the hydration error is causing the entire root to switch to client rendering, likely rendering incorrect content. The step-3b page at apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx likely reads style data from localStorage or sessionStorage (unavailable during SSR), causing the server to render fallback/empty state that mismatches client state.

issues.description: Hydration error: server HTML does not match client HTML across multiple components. The root switches entirely to client rendering, causing visual corruption — the step-1 room selector appears instead of step-3b content.
issues.element: Hydration across step-3 and step-3b pages
issues.root_cause: In apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx (and step-3/page.tsx), state is likely initialized directly from localStorage/sessionStorage or Math.random() at the module/component level without a useEffect or 'use client' + mounted guard, causing SSR to produce different HTML than the client hydration pass.

issues.description: Style blend confirmation screen (step-3b) shows no percentage bars, no style names, no 'This feels right' button — none of the expected UI elements are present.
issues.element: Style blend UI elements on step-3b
issues.root_cause: Either apps/web/app/design/step-3b/page.tsx does not exist or renders nothing due to the hydration crash causing fallback to a different page's content.

fixes.reason: Prevents SSR/client mismatch by deferring localStorage reads to useEffect after mount, eliminating the hydration error that causes wrong content to render.
Fixes the confirmed hydration mismatch in step-3/page.tsx reported in console logs ('Which room are we designing? Style Quiz' mismatch) by guarding localStorage access behind useEffect.
